rows.sql: SELECT uses_knowledge_graph, MAX(baseline_amount) AS max_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE uses_knowledge_graph IN ('Yes', 'No') AND baseline_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY uses_knowledge_graph

SELECT CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Hybrid%' THEN 'Hybrid' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Graph-based%' THEN 'Graph-based' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Dense%' THEN 'Dense' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Sparse%' THEN 'Sparse' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Web Search%' THEN 'Web Search' WHEN retrieval_method != '' THEN 'Other' END AS retrieval_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE reasoning_depth = 'multi-hop' AND retrieval_method != '' GROUP BY retrieval_family

SELECT CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Medical%' THEN 'Medical' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Education%' THEN 'Education' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Academic%' THEN 'Academic' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%General%' THEN 'General' WHEN application_domain != '' THEN 'Other' END AS domain_family, multi_turn_retrieval, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE application_domain != '' AND multi_turn_retrieval IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY domain_family, multi_turn_retrieval

SELECT CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Hybrid%' THEN 'Hybrid' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Graph-based%' THEN 'Graph-based' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Dense%' THEN 'Dense' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Sparse%' THEN 'Sparse' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Web Search%' THEN 'Web Search' WHEN retrieval_method != '' THEN 'Other' END AS retrieval_family, CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Image%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Audio%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Table%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Code%' THEN 'multimodal_or_structured' WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Text%' THEN 'text_only' WHEN data_modality != '' THEN 'Other' END AS modality_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE retrieval_method != '' AND data_modality != '' GROUP BY retrieval_family, modality_family
SELECT uses_reranker, use_agent, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE uses_reranker IN ('Yes', 'No') AND use_agent IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY uses_reranker, use_agent

SELECT CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Medical%' THEN 'Medical' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Education%' THEN 'Education' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Academic%' THEN 'Academic' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%General%' THEN 'General' WHEN application_domain != '' THEN 'Other' END AS domain_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, SUM(CASE WHEN reasoning_depth = 'multi-hop' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_hop_count, SUM(CASE WHEN use_agent = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agent_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE application_domain != '' AND baseline_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY domain_family

SELECT CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Medical%' THEN 'Medical' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Education%' THEN 'Education' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Academic%' THEN 'Academic' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%General%' THEN 'General' WHEN application_domain != '' THEN 'Other' END AS domain_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE baseline_amount BETWEEN 2 AND 6 AND application_domain != '' GROUP BY domain_family
SELECT topic, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE topic != '' GROUP BY topic
SELECT reasoning_depth, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE baseline_amount >= 4 AND reasoning_depth IN ('single-hop', 'multi-hop') GROUP BY reasoning_depth

SELECT use_agent, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, SUM(CASE WHEN uses_reranker = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reranker_count FROM cspaper WHERE use_agent IN ('Yes', 'No') AND baseline_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY use_agent
SELECT uses_reranker, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE data_modality LIKE '%Image%' AND uses_reranker IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY uses_reranker
SELECT multi_turn_retrieval, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE use_agent = 'Yes' AND multi_turn_retrieval IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY multi_turn_retrieval

SELECT CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Image%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Audio%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Table%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Code%' THEN 'multimodal_or_structured' WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Text%' THEN 'text_only' WHEN data_modality != '' THEN 'Other' END AS modality_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, SUM(CASE WHEN uses_reranker = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reranker_count FROM cspaper WHERE data_modality != '' AND baseline_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY modality_family

SELECT CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Medical%' THEN 'Medical' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Education%' THEN 'Education' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Academic%' THEN 'Academic' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%General%' THEN 'General' WHEN application_domain != '' THEN 'Other' END AS domain_family, uses_knowledge_graph, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE application_domain != '' AND uses_knowledge_graph IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY domain_family, uses_knowledge_graph
SELECT uses_reranker, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE baseline_amount >= 5 AND uses_reranker IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY uses_reranker
SELECT uses_knowledge_graph, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE reasoning_depth = 'multi-hop' AND use_agent = 'Yes' AND uses_knowledge_graph IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY uses_knowledge_graph

SELECT CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Image%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Audio%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Table%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Code%' THEN 'multimodal_or_structured' WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Text%' THEN 'text_only' WHEN data_modality != '' THEN 'Other' END AS modality_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, SUM(CASE WHEN multi_turn_retrieval = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_turn_count FROM cspaper WHERE data_modality != '' AND baseline_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY modality_family

SELECT use_agent, reasoning_depth, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, MAX(baseline_amount) AS max_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE use_agent IN ('Yes', 'No') AND reasoning_depth IN ('single-hop', 'multi-hop') AND baseline_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY use_agent, reasoning_depth

SELECT CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Hybrid%' THEN 'Hybrid' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Graph-based%' THEN 'Graph-based' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Dense%' THEN 'Dense' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Sparse%' THEN 'Sparse' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Web Search%' THEN 'Web Search' WHEN retrieval_method != '' THEN 'Other' END AS retrieval_family, use_agent, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE retrieval_method != '' AND use_agent IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY retrieval_family, use_agent

SELECT CASE WHEN baseline_amount <= 3 THEN 'few_baselines' ELSE 'many_baselines' END AS baseline_band, uses_reranker, multi_turn_retrieval, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE baseline_amount IS NOT NULL AND uses_reranker IN ('Yes', 'No') AND multi_turn_retrieval IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY baseline_band, uses_reranker, multi_turn_retrieval

SELECT reasoning_depth, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, MAX(baseline_amount) AS max_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE reasoning_depth IN ('single-hop', 'multi-hop') AND baseline_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY reasoning_depth

SELECT CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Hybrid%' THEN 'Hybrid' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Graph-based%' THEN 'Graph-based' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Dense%' THEN 'Dense' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Sparse%' THEN 'Sparse' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Web Search%' THEN 'Web Search' WHEN retrieval_method != '' THEN 'Other' END AS retrieval_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, SUM(CASE WHEN uses_knowledge_graph = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kg_count FROM cspaper WHERE retrieval_method != '' AND baseline_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY retrieval_family HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
SELECT use_agent, multi_turn_retrieval, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE use_agent IN ('Yes', 'No') AND multi_turn_retrieval IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY use_agent, multi_turn_retrieval

SELECT reasoning_depth, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE retrieval_method LIKE '%Dense%' AND uses_knowledge_graph = 'No' AND reasoning_depth IN ('single-hop', 'multi-hop') GROUP BY reasoning_depth

SELECT CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Hybrid%' THEN 'Hybrid' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Graph-based%' THEN 'Graph-based' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Dense%' THEN 'Dense' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Sparse%' THEN 'Sparse' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Web Search%' THEN 'Web Search' WHEN retrieval_method != '' THEN 'Other' END AS retrieval_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE application_domain LIKE '%General%' AND retrieval_method != '' GROUP BY retrieval_family

SELECT uses_knowledge_graph, uses_reranker, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE uses_knowledge_graph IN ('Yes', 'No') AND uses_reranker IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY uses_knowledge_graph, uses_reranker
SELECT use_agent, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE use_agent IN ('Yes', 'No') AND baseline_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY use_agent

SELECT CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Medical%' THEN 'Medical' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Education%' THEN 'Education' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Academic%' THEN 'Academic' WHEN application_domain LIKE '%General%' THEN 'General' WHEN application_domain != '' THEN 'Other' END AS domain_family, use_agent, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE application_domain != '' AND use_agent IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY domain_family, use_agent

SELECT CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Image%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Audio%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Table%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Code%' THEN 'multimodal_or_structured' WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Text%' THEN 'text_only' WHEN data_modality != '' THEN 'Other' END AS modality_family, uses_reranker, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE data_modality != '' AND uses_reranker IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY modality_family, uses_reranker

SELECT multi_turn_retrieval, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, SUM(CASE WHEN use_agent = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agent_count FROM cspaper WHERE multi_turn_retrieval IN ('Yes', 'No') AND baseline_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY multi_turn_retrieval

SELECT CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Hybrid%' THEN 'Hybrid' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Graph-based%' THEN 'Graph-based' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Dense%' THEN 'Dense' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Sparse%' THEN 'Sparse' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Web Search%' THEN 'Web Search' WHEN retrieval_method != '' THEN 'Other' END AS retrieval_family, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE uses_reranker = 'No' AND baseline_amount IS NOT NULL AND retrieval_method != '' GROUP BY retrieval_family

SELECT CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Hybrid%' THEN 'Hybrid' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Graph-based%' THEN 'Graph-based' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Dense%' THEN 'Dense' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Sparse%' THEN 'Sparse' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Web Search%' THEN 'Web Search' WHEN retrieval_method != '' THEN 'Other' END AS retrieval_family, MAX(baseline_amount) AS max_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE retrieval_method != '' AND baseline_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY retrieval_family

SELECT use_agent, multi_turn_retrieval, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE (use_agent IN ('Yes', 'No') AND multi_turn_retrieval IN ('Yes', 'No')) AND evaluation_metric LIKE '%accuracy%' GROUP BY use_agent, multi_turn_retrieval
SELECT generator_model, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE generator_model IN ('GPT-4o', 'GPT-4') AND NOT baseline_amount IS NULL GROUP BY generator_model

SELECT CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Image%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Audio%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Table%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Code%' THEN 'multimodal_or_structured' WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Text%' THEN 'text_only' WHEN data_modality <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS modality_family, reasoning_depth, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE (data_modality <> '' AND reasoning_depth IN ('single-hop', 'multi-hop')) AND baseline LIKE '%0-shot%' GROUP BY modality_family, reasoning_depth

SELECT CASE WHEN generator_model LIKE '%gpt-4o%' THEN 'Hybrid' WHEN generator_model LIKE '%gpt-4%' THEN 'Graph-based' WHEN generator_model LIKE '%gpt-3.5%' THEN 'Dense' WHEN generator_model LIKE '%llama-2-7b%' THEN 'Sparse' WHEN generator_model LIKE '%qwen2.5-7b-instruct%' THEN 'Web Search' WHEN generator_model <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS retrieval_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE application_domain LIKE '%General%' AND generator_model <> '' GROUP BY retrieval_family
SELECT generator_model, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE generator_model IN ('GPT-4o', 'GPT-4') AND NOT baseline_amount IS NULL GROUP BY generator_model
SELECT reasoning_depth, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE reasoning_depth IN ('single-hop', 'multi-hop') AND evaluation_dataset LIKE '%hotpotqa%' GROUP BY reasoning_depth

SELECT CASE WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%bleu-1%' OR performance_on_NQ LIKE '%budgetleak-p%' OR performance_on_NQ LIKE '%accuracy%' OR performance_on_NQ LIKE '%54.0%' THEN 'multimodal_or_structured' WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%sd-ra-it%' THEN 'text_only' WHEN performance_on_NQ <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS modality_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE retrieval_method LIKE '%Hybrid%' AND performance_on_NQ <> '' GROUP BY modality_family

SELECT CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Image%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Audio%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Table%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Code%' THEN 'multimodal_or_structured' WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Text%' THEN 'text_only' WHEN data_modality <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS modality_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, SUM(CASE WHEN generator_model = 'GPT-4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_turn_count FROM cspaper WHERE data_modality <> '' AND NOT baseline_amount IS NULL GROUP BY modality_family
SELECT generator_model, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE generator_model IN ('GPT-4o', 'GPT-4') GROUP BY generator_model
SELECT uses_knowledge_graph, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE evaluation_metric LIKE '%accuracy%' AND uses_knowledge_graph IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY uses_knowledge_graph
SELECT uses_reranker, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE (uses_knowledge_graph = 'Yes' AND uses_reranker IN ('Yes', 'No')) AND evaluation_metric LIKE '%accuracy%' GROUP BY uses_reranker

SELECT CASE WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%sd-ra-it%' THEN 'Hybrid' WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%54.0%' THEN 'Graph-based' WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%accuracy%' THEN 'Dense' WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%bleu-1%' THEN 'Sparse' WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%budgetleak-p%' THEN 'Web Search' WHEN performance_on_NQ <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS retrieval_family, reasoning_depth, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, SUM(CASE WHEN uses_reranker = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reranker_count FROM cspaper WHERE performance_on_NQ <> '' AND reasoning_depth IN ('single-hop', 'multi-hop') AND NOT baseline_amount IS NULL GROUP BY retrieval_family, reasoning_depth HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
SELECT multi_turn_retrieval, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, generator_model FROM cspaper WHERE use_agent = 'Yes' AND multi_turn_retrieval IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY multi_turn_retrieval, generator_model

SELECT agent_framework, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, MAX(baseline_amount) AS max_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE (agent_framework IN ('CoT', 'ToT', 'Multi-Agent Collaboration', 'Other') AND NOT baseline_amount IS NULL) AND baseline LIKE '%0-shot%' GROUP BY agent_framework

SELECT reasoning_depth, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, MAX(baseline_amount) AS max_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE (reasoning_depth IN ('single-hop', 'multi-hop') AND NOT baseline_amount IS NULL) AND generator_model = 'GPT-3.5' GROUP BY reasoning_depth

SELECT CASE WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa LIKE '%sd-ra-it%' THEN 'Medical' WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa LIKE '%accuracy%' THEN 'Education' WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa LIKE '%~0.62%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa LIKE '%compression%' THEN 'Academic' WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa LIKE '%conflict%' THEN 'General' WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS domain_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, SUM(CASE WHEN use_agent = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agent_count FROM cspaper WHERE performance_on_hotpotqa <> '' AND NOT baseline_amount IS NULL GROUP BY domain_family

SELECT CASE WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa LIKE '%sd-ra-it%' THEN 'Medical' WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa LIKE '%accuracy%' THEN 'Education' WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa LIKE '%~0.62%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa LIKE '%compression%' THEN 'Academic' WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa LIKE '%conflict%' THEN 'General' WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS domain_family, uses_knowledge_graph, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE performance_on_hotpotqa <> '' AND uses_knowledge_graph IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY domain_family, uses_knowledge_graph

SELECT generator_model, reasoning_depth, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE generator_model IN ('GPT-4o', 'GPT-4', 'GPT-3.5', 'LLaMA-2-7B') AND reasoning_depth IN ('single-hop', 'multi-hop') GROUP BY generator_model, reasoning_depth

SELECT uses_reranker, multi_turn_retrieval, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE (uses_reranker IN ('Yes', 'No') AND multi_turn_retrieval IN ('Yes', 'No')) AND evaluation_metric LIKE '%accuracy%' GROUP BY uses_reranker, multi_turn_retrieval
SELECT uses_reranker, generator_model, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE uses_reranker IN ('Yes', 'No') AND generator_model IN ('GPT-4o', 'GPT-4') GROUP BY uses_reranker, generator_model

SELECT reasoning_depth, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE (reasoning_depth IN ('single-hop', 'multi-hop') AND NOT baseline_amount IS NULL) AND baseline LIKE '%0-shot%' GROUP BY reasoning_depth

SELECT CASE WHEN baseline LIKE '%0-shot%' THEN 'Medical' WHEN baseline LIKE '%asrbaseline%' THEN 'Education' WHEN baseline LIKE '%bert-cls%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN baseline LIKE '%bert-based%' THEN 'Academic' WHEN baseline LIKE '%bert%' THEN 'General' WHEN baseline <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS domain_family, use_agent, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE baseline <> '' AND use_agent IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY domain_family, use_agent

SELECT CASE WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%sd-ra-it%' THEN 'Hybrid' WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%54.0%' THEN 'Graph-based' WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%accuracy%' THEN 'Dense' WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%bleu-1%' THEN 'Sparse' WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%budgetleak-p%' THEN 'Web Search' WHEN performance_on_NQ <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS retrieval_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, SUM(CASE WHEN uses_knowledge_graph = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kg_count FROM cspaper WHERE performance_on_NQ <> '' AND NOT baseline_amount IS NULL GROUP BY retrieval_family HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

SELECT CASE WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%sd-ra-it%' THEN 'Hybrid' WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%54.0%' THEN 'Graph-based' WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%accuracy%' THEN 'Dense' WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%bleu-1%' THEN 'Sparse' WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%budgetleak-p%' THEN 'Web Search' WHEN performance_on_NQ <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS retrieval_family, use_agent, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE performance_on_NQ <> '' AND use_agent IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY retrieval_family, use_agent
SELECT uses_reranker, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE generator_model LIKE '%gpt-4o%' AND uses_reranker IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY uses_reranker

SELECT CASE WHEN generator_model LIKE '%gpt-4o%' THEN 'Medical' WHEN generator_model LIKE '%gpt-4%' THEN 'Education' WHEN generator_model LIKE '%gpt-3.5%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN generator_model LIKE '%llama-2-7b%' THEN 'Academic' WHEN generator_model LIKE '%qwen2.5-7b-instruct%' THEN 'General' WHEN generator_model <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS domain_family, multi_turn_retrieval, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE generator_model <> '' AND multi_turn_retrieval IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY domain_family, multi_turn_retrieval

SELECT multi_turn_retrieval, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, SUM(CASE WHEN use_agent = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agent_count FROM cspaper WHERE (multi_turn_retrieval IN ('Yes', 'No') AND NOT baseline_amount IS NULL) AND baseline LIKE '%0-shot%' GROUP BY multi_turn_retrieval
SELECT generator_model, MAX(baseline_amount) AS max_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE generator_model IN ('GPT-4o', 'GPT-4') AND NOT baseline_amount IS NULL GROUP BY generator_model

SELECT CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Hybrid%' THEN 'Hybrid' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Graph-based%' THEN 'Graph-based' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Dense%' THEN 'Dense' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Sparse%' THEN 'Sparse' WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Web Search%' THEN 'Web Search' WHEN retrieval_method <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS retrieval_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE retrieval_method <> '' AND evaluation_metric LIKE '%accuracy%' GROUP BY retrieval_family

SELECT CASE WHEN generator_model LIKE '%gpt-4o%' THEN 'Hybrid' WHEN generator_model LIKE '%gpt-4%' THEN 'Graph-based' WHEN generator_model LIKE '%gpt-3.5%' THEN 'Dense' WHEN generator_model LIKE '%llama-2-7b%' THEN 'Sparse' WHEN generator_model LIKE '%qwen2.5-7b-instruct%' THEN 'Web Search' WHEN generator_model <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS retrieval_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE reasoning_depth = 'multi-hop' AND generator_model <> '' GROUP BY retrieval_family

SELECT CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Image%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Audio%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Table%' OR data_modality LIKE '%Code%' THEN 'multimodal_or_structured' WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Text%' THEN 'text_only' WHEN data_modality <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS modality_family, generator_model, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE data_modality <> '' AND generator_model IN ('GPT-4o', 'GPT-4') GROUP BY modality_family, generator_model

SELECT CASE WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%bleu-1%' OR performance_on_NQ LIKE '%budgetleak-p%' OR performance_on_NQ LIKE '%accuracy%' OR performance_on_NQ LIKE '%54.0%' THEN 'multimodal_or_structured' WHEN performance_on_NQ LIKE '%sd-ra-it%' THEN 'text_only' WHEN performance_on_NQ <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS modality_family, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM cspaper WHERE performance_on_NQ <> '' GROUP BY modality_family
